description: BIYA candidate-validation case spec. Fixture provenance: SANITIZED_LOCAL_ARTIFACT. Every artifact below is real local evidence recorded in docs/phase-2v-biya-artifact-inventory.md, with absolute paths reduced to workspace-relative form and the Finviz credential present in ART-001 excluded entirely. Every original field value is UNKNOWN because no surviving artifact records one; those unknowns must not be filled from later data.

limitations: contains no timestamps of any kind
records no BIYA field value, score, or label
all 43 BIYA lines are IB subscription errors or Schwab DNS failures
contains a live provider credential and is therefore never published
auto-transcribed and lossy on ticker symbols
records an observer's description of the screen, not the platform's own output
bounds when BIYA was discussed, not when it was surfaced
written after the meeting it describes
its verification used fabricated ticker data that is not evidence about the original event
its modification time reflects when the document was authored, not when BIYA was surfaced
commit times record when code was written, not when a candidate was surfaced
contains no mention of BIYA
contains no message later than 2026-07-17
does not contain the reported message that BIYA squeezed as predicted
bounds nothing about BIYA's detection because it never references the symbol

detection_time.confidence_basis: Screener run start bounds below and the application log's last write bounds above. The advisor recording filename independently confirms BIYA was on screen inside the interval. No artifact records a platform event time, so no exact timestamp is claimed.
evidence_notes: BIYA's first log line is at file line 4, so it was surfaced essentially at screener startup
the 8m43s meeting interval bounds discussion, not detection, and is not substituted for the surfacing window
the advisor's '4:00 a.m.' remark describes BIYA's price move, not a detection event

rule_validations.rationale: score_setup() awards one point each for a price band, a 10 percent change threshold, a relative-volume threshold, and a 5 percent short-float floor. None of the four is a squeeze mechanic: borrow fee, days to cover, and TTM Squeeze are computed and displayed but never scored. The rubric is a usable low-float-mover discovery filter; the Prime/Subprime vocabulary asserts a conclusion its inputs cannot support.
corrections_required: rename the output so it describes momentum discovery rather than a squeeze setup
keep discovery separate from short-pressure confirmation instead of collapsing both into one label

rule_validations.rationale: The arithmetic is the textbook short-interest-as-percent-of-float formula and is correct. The column was renamed from 'Short Float %' to 'Short Interest %' 2h04m before the meeting; unqualified 'Short Interest' denotes an absolute share count, so the header misdescribes a ratio. The advisor's live remark that BIYA's short interest 'appears to be low, and I am not sure why' is consistent with reading a percent-of-float under that heading.
corrections_required: display the percent-of-float ratio and the absolute short-interest share count as separate, unambiguously labelled fields

rule_validations.rationale: The denominator is a trailing mean of completed daily bars that correctly excludes the incomplete current bar, matching the rebuilt Phase 2C contract, and missing inputs return None with a reason rather than zero. The defect is presentation: the numerator derives from a twice-monthly FINRA filing yet is shown beside live price and volume with no reporting-period age, and the denominator came from a cache with a one-hour TTL at detection.
corrections_required: surface reporting-period age and availability age alongside the value
never present a ratio built on a twice-monthly filing as real time

rule_validations.rationale: A missing publication time becomes the literal string 'Unknown time' and a missing title becomes 'No title', so absence is type-indistinguishable from a real value and no downstream code can filter on recency or establish whether an item existed at detection.
corrections_required: separate publication, update, capture, and receipt time

rule_validations.rationale: The application log records IB error 10089 for every symbol including BIYA: the account lacked the required market-data subscription, so the screener fell back to delayed data. Every price, change percent, and relative volume observed during the session was delayed, and the interface carried no delayed-data indicator.
corrections_required: display an explicit data-delay indicator per field
treat real-time market data as an acquisition prerequisite rather than an assumption

rule_validations.rationale: Corroboration reapplies the same four-point rubric to a second provider's numbers, so agreement tests data agreement rather than rule validity. During the observed run it was moot: every corroboration call failed with DNS resolution errors, and the absence was not surfaced in the interface.
corrections_required: corroborate with an independent criterion rather than the same rubric
surface corroboration failure explicitly instead of degrading silently

rule_validations.rationale: Its missing-input handling is genuinely sound: None in, None out, excluded from the composite and never treated as zero. At detection it was displayed as an independent column and did not gate Prime/Subprime, so a ticker could show a low composite score and still be labelled Prime.
corrections_required: report the per-component evidence separately rather than collapsing it into one number
do not reinstate a composite as a classification gate

limitations: no BIYA market bar exists in the workspace at any interval on any date
outcome measurement requires acquiring historical bars; see the acquisition manifest
an outcome could not validate the methodology in any case, because no original BIYA value survives to compare against
every original BIYA field value is unknown; the only direct platform record preserves no value, score, or label
detection time is bounded to roughly 2h31m and is not exactly recorded
the original rules are reconstructed from the pre-meeting commit, not the archived working tree
no outcome window is computable from local evidence
one case cannot validate or invalidate a methodology in general
